item.tib: 'bum bskul yum sras gsum gyi gnad 'dus
item.coloph: de yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ ma yengs drung mu gshen gyi rigs/ phyi rabs skal ldan blo rmongs rnams/ gcod gdams rin chen 'phreng ba las/ phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang gi dmigs pa gsol 'debs gzhung ltar ro/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs dang*/ ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul rnams/ ma brjed thugs kyi dkyil du sbos/ gsung nas bka' rgya btab/ de'i sras su gyur pa'i yum khyed gnyis kyang / yon tan zur tsam yab yum khyed gnyis la bshags/ phyi rabs bu las can kyang spyod yul lo/ da ni 'bum bskul gyis (gyi) lag len no/ sprul sku'i snyan rgyud rim bzhin/ bdag cu ra 'od zer rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas bka' rnams yi ge ris su bris pa 'di kha cig go/
